name: Wmns Air Jordan 4 Retro TEX 'Worn Blue Denim'
story_html: The Women's Air Jordan 4 Retro TEX 'Worn Blue Denim' is crafted from cotton denim in two different washes. Quarter panel netting is replaced with contrast stitch detailing. In addition to Jumpman branding on the tongue and heel tab, branding elements include a 'Family' lace dubrae in metallic gold. Lightweight cushioning arrives via a white polyurethane midsole, fitted with an Air-sole heel unit and supported by a gum rubber outsole.
